extracted.name: California Farm Cauliflower Cheese Pepper Sauce
extracted.description: A family favorite. Simple to make, turns steamed cauliflower florets into a delicacy.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 cup grated white cheddar aged cheese
instruction_lines: In cast iron skillet, brown flour in melted butter, add milk, cream,mustard powder, stir till smooth, add grated cheese, stir till melted, pour over steamed cauliflower. Sprinkle ground fresh black pepper on top, serve. Enjoy
